contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CP LIC GALLIENVS AVG

A copper alloy Roman silver wash radiate of Gallienus (AD 253-268), probably struck in Milan between AD 260-267. This coin is counted as one of the irregular coinages in the Normanby hoard (no. 1683), having the reverse type VIRTVS AVG with Virtus standing with spear and shield, but with the obverse inscription IMP CP LIC GALLIENVS AVG
